scope.numerical_predictions_replay: Separate parent audit; reported scores below are not newly recomputed model predictions in this review.

verified.details: Every manifest row species/origin/group/workbook agrees with the 18-workbook user confirmation and active registry. All 1672 IDs and eleven identity/label/source fields agree with pinned metadata; no observed label mismatch.
Historical plan and metadata were read from immutable pinned raw URLs into memory only and SHA checked against protocol. Added-role SHA256(seed:group) -> PCG64 allocation independently replayed.

binary_kinds uses only 枣仁/酸枣仁 labels; acid_origins filters 酸枣仁 and labels ZY03..ZY07; each other within-kind task filters the proper Chinese kind before origin-group scoring. Four-kind identification is separate. Chinese user-confirmed labels are not independent Latin botanical authentication.

Classifier inner selection receives X/y/IDs of train only; two-fold validation chooses fixed candidates before prediction. Hash-verified historical fit_transform_bundle fits scaler/MC selector on its current training partition only; caches include training X/y fingerprints. Full refit explicitly uses train+CAL only and is a separate method. Calibration PCA/distance context fits source only; the two selected anchor adapters fit support scores/labels, with no query labels or query statistics.

Source SVC vote and score argmax are both retained, making score-correction gains interpretable against the same argmax rule. K=1/3/5/10 draws are nested within each repeat, use CAL only, and are shared across methods. Full calibration-pool retraining is not called K-shot frozen-model calibration. Repeated support draws share a fixed prediction cohort and do not increase independent N.

A target-only, Aextra 120-step target-pretraining budget control and B 120 alternating Huangqi/Tianma pretraining steps use paired seeds42/43/44 and a fresh target head. B uses only HQ241/TM242 TRAIN records, independent source-origin heads, and source-only task scalers. No direct source-origin score-column mapping to target origins. Target-training order and initial encoder/head hashes are paired. Prediction packs omit origin labels; bytes are locked before a separate hash-checked truth join. This is representation initialization plus full target training on300 labels, followed by optional support-score calibration; it is not K-shot-only target learning.

Independently recomputed from saved 7x7 confusion matrices only. Original per-record historical prediction archive was not replayed here. The +42 acid-group contribution does not imply improved species-binary performance, which fell by one after label collapse.

findings.evidence: scripts/run_species_revision_classification.py: main validates ID set and physical-ID uniqueness, but task_arrays takes species/origin labels from the NPZ and main does not assert per-ID equality to split labels or a prespecified expected feature audit hash. frozen_config records hashes of whichever files are supplied and prevents same-output config changes; it does not by itself prove the first supplied NPZ has the intended labels.
findings.consequence: An alternative same-ID NPZ with stale mixed-species labels could enter a newly initialized output directory undetected by this adapter. No evidence establishes that this occurred in the pinned completed run.
findings.recommended_future_fix: Before any future fit, assert NPZ species/origin/group/dataset per ID exactly equals the frozen manifest, manifest equals protocol hash, and features digest equals the prepared feature audit digest. Preserve completed inputs/results; do not silently relabel cached NPZ.

findings.evidence: All1672 batch_id fields empty. Prior ZY groups each have one user-declared source batch; original855 have historical development exposure. New817 physical independence is a distinct user declaration without batch metadata.
findings.consequence: Specimen role isolation is verified, but kind/origin recognition may include source-group/batch/acquisition differences. Current100% binary score does not establish held-origin, real cross-batch, cross-instrument or external generalization. The pinned report correctly limits the claim.

The high jujube-origin aggregate accuracy is dominated by ZY01. One-example class rates and fixed-parameter diagnostics do not support reliable five-origin claims. These classes cannot support normal stratified tuning or higher-shot calibration.

findings.details: Paired A/Aextra/B controls allow this fixed scheme to be compared, but no shuffled-source-label/irrelevant-source negative-control arm is present. Equal120 optimizer steps is a training-step budget control, not measured FLOP equivalence across four-/five-class heads. With B reported below both controls, positive cross-species transfer is unsupported; no mechanism or general impossibility claim follows. No new fit is required to interpret the current negative result.

Species-specific origin scores condition on the known true kind. They are not an end-to-end hierarchical identification score. A species mistake must count as a system error even if the true-kind origin model would be correct. Parent is separately replaying stored prediction CSVs; do not multiply marginal accuracies or train a duplicate system.

Four known-kind classification has no held-out unknown-kind rejection experiment. Alpha+n fusion, additional PLS-DA/CARS runs, botanical authentication, chemical content, quality grade, efficacy and mixture-ratio inference are not established by these origin labels. A stated method in inherited_methods does not show an executed current experiment.

reported_numbers_qualification.source: Pinned docs/SPECIES_REVISION_RESULTS_20261108.md; values below remain source-reported until separate prediction replay.

binary.qualification: Fixed internal specimen holdout, historically exposed ZY plus new tiny groups; no external/batch claim.

acid_R2.qualification: Source300 labels vs full refit400 target labels; cannot attribute6 extra successes to frozen K-shot calibration.

acid_R0.qualification: Retain alongside R2; cannot select R0 as predeclared winner after viewing prediction scores.

transfer_source_accuracy_means.qualification: Paired seeds42/43/44 and same100 query subjects, not three independent cohorts or cross-batch confidence.

reported_numbers_qualification.report_scope_assessment: Pinned report explicitly preserves negative calibration/transfer, historical exposure, tiny classes, missing batch confirmation, and nonexecuted experiments. No material contradiction with the reviewed adapters was found.

review_limits: Static source inspection does not prove every historical runtime action.

Actual features.npz, all17 reused source modules and nine fitted neural weight files were not independently replayed by this reviewer. Four critical reused modules were exact-SHA checked and inspected.
Current classification and transfer CSV metric replay and end-to-end count reconstruction are a separate parent audit.
No user-authorized physical independence declaration was treated as laboratory verification or as batch counts.
conclusion_zh: 已核实修正后逐样品标签及训练/校准/预测角色衔接一致，未发现现有入口存在把校准或预测样品用于选参拟合的源码路径。当前成绩可作为内部回顾性识别与校准/迁移对照，不能升级为真实跨批次、外部验证或完整分层系统性能。分类NPZ标签与名单的强绑定建议在后续入口补齐；这是一项防错缺口，现有资料未证明已造成错误。
